subject: okinawa
story_title: Japan holds a U.S. Marine in the killing of an Okinawa woman, and Okinawa says U.S. discipline measures have failed

sources_admitted.evidence: 115 records pinned under data/sources/okinawa and data/sources/coverage; admit.py check passes with 239 brief citations and 0 failures. No police release exists to admit; the police account comes through Okinawa Times, Jiji, Mainichi, Yomiuri, Ryukyu Shimpo and a police spokesman quoted by Stars and Stripes.

derived_numbers_computed.evidence: The data module derives nothing: every figure (101 and 73 cases, 80 people, 6,409 and 6,285, 70.3% and 40.8%, 31 of 76, 23 days, 48 hours, 30 days, 197 officers, 6 requests and 5 handovers) is printed on an admitted record named in the module's comments.

outlet_claims_verified.evidence: Fourteen outlet claims compared with the primary records in the brief: arrest place (AP first version, NPR, UPI), arrest timing, arrests vs cases vs people (AP, CBS, DW, Al Jazeera, BBC), denied the charges and charged with murder (Al Jazeera, CBS), the wallet and backpack, custody vs jurisdiction (BBC), the Futenma forecast (Reuters), record high (QAB), the family statement (DW, CBS), 70% of facilities (AP), troop totals.

section_grammar.evidence: What happened, the night of October 3, thirty years of measures, what each side says, the catch, what happens next, the records. The chronology, patrol details and coverage tables are detail blocks.

chip_vocabulary.evidence: SourcedBlock kinds used: record and checked only.

live_elements_guarded.evidence: The page has no live element; every record is a fixed saved copy.

subject_page_updated.evidence: New series page /events/okinawa/ with its subject module (dek matching the story, one figure: 23 days to decide on charges, from moj-criminal-justice-faq) and a series entry in src/lib/discovery.mjs.

homepage_updated.evidence: The story is in the discovery editorial map, so the homepage and series listings pick it up; the card title is the published state label, renamed in catch-state to match the h1.
